scores.overall_note: impl-08 ('Ledgerline') is a single-screen change-set timeline that fits the brief tightly: 42 changes with explicit cause edges over a 36h window on component swimlanes, phase bands naming the temporal narrative, a playback cursor with speed control, a pre-selected change exposing its 因/果 chains, and three metric sparklines sharing the same time window (data.js:28-89, app.js:103-339, both screenshots). The acceptance seed is not merely depicted but machine-checked at load — '时序校验 33/33 通过 ✓' (app.js:14-24) — and delivered with no loading state, satisfying the static-open and first-screen-ready constraints (index.html:7,64-65; app.js:416-422). Navigation and context costs are minimal: everything is reachable in one click and selection dims rather than hides. The weaknesses are concentrated in accessibility and micro-typography — the receipt fails a11y.contrast and type.min_projected_size, muted small labels sit near 3.8:1, timeline nodes are mouse-only without focus affordances, and one axis label clips — while all layout checks pass and no structural rework signals appear. Preference, completion time, and retrieval accuracy are withheld per blind protocol; the understandability judgment here is a model proxy, not a human one.
